body:
INSTAGRAM
Using Claude to build a VGC team the right way: AI for ideas, tools for maths, you for the final call.

Claude is great at threat lists, partner ideas and game plans.
It is bad at damage ranges, speed tiers and EV spreads. It guesses.
So I connected it to a calculator with an MCP server I built, vgc-mcp, and now it runs real calcs mid-conversation.
What is your core? Drop it in the comments and I'll ask Claude for partners.
